concerns.text: Task T015 references 'data/processed/connectivity_matrices/' but doesn't explicitly state *how* to verify the `.npy` files contain data matching the standard EEG montage.  Needs a concrete verification step.
Task T016 mentions verifying formula constraints, but doesn't specify *what* values or tolerances are acceptable.  Needs a defined acceptance criterion (e.g., 'max deviation < 1e-6').
Task T018c is incomplete. It states to aggregate sensitivity results, but doesn't specify *how* to aggregate them or what the expected output of the aggregation is.
Task T019 only verifies the *existence* of the `trace_id` column, not that it contains valid SHA-256 hashes. This is a critical traceability requirement and needs to be verified.
Task T020 only mentions validating the output schema, but doesn't specify *how* this validation will be performed (e.g., using a schema validation library).

Task T023 mentions implementing Spearman correlation, but doesn't explicitly state how the `cognitive_instrument` validation from T025a/b/c is integrated into the analysis.  Needs clarification on how invalid/missing data is handled.
Task T027 mentions power analysis, but doesn't specify *what* effect size is being tested or what the acceptance criteria for sufficient power are.
Task T031 states it depends on T008, but T008 is not fully completed (T008_run is still open). This dependency needs to be addressed.
Task T034 mentions generating a regression table, but doesn't specify *what* metrics should be included in the table.
Task T035 mentions validating the output schema, but doesn't specify *how* this validation will be performed.
Task T047 mentions integration testing, but doesn't specify *what* aspects of the streaming implementation are being tested.
Task T048 mentions integration testing, but doesn't specify *what* is being tested.
Task T051 requires a data-quality check for valid epochs, but doesn't specify what happens to participants who fail this check. Is their data excluded from all analyses?
Task T052 requires generating a summary report, but doesn't specify the format or content of the report beyond the listed metrics.
Task T053 requires sensitivity analysis, but doesn't specify the range of values to test for the artifact thresholds.
Task T056 mentions network topology visualizations, but doesn't specify *how* these visualizations will be generated or what parameters will be used.
Task T058 mentions adding a CI workflow, but doesn't specify *what* tests or checks will be included in the workflow.
Task T059 mentions unit tests for visualizations, but doesn't specify *what* aspects of the visualizations will be tested.
Task T060 mentions documenting power analysis, but doesn't specify *where* this documentation will be located or what information it should include.
Task T061 mentions handling missing cognitive scores, but doesn't specify *how* this will be implemented in the analysis pipeline.
Task T062 mentions updating the version map, but doesn't specify *when* this update will occur (e.g., after each task completion or at the end of a phase).
Task T063 mentions creating a Dockerfile, but doesn't specify *what* dependencies or configurations will be included in the Dockerfile.
